_: Voice narration on GitHub with Gemini TTS (.github/workflows/narration-tts.yml). Edit, commit, push: the workflow voices what is listed and commits the takes to audio/vo-takes/. `scripts`: synth-vo.py scripts to voice in `voice`. Bump `run` to re-run with no other change. Voice each line once (the daily quota is shared).

takes.name: buried-b
takes.text: Right down there, buried with everything else you saved,
takes.style: Wry and warm, pointing down into a deep hole, then letting it land: "buried with everything else you saved" said plainly, the sentence carrying on; no drawn-out words. Pace: Easy and conversational, about 160 words a minute; one short beat after "there,", no rush. The product name "Machina" is the Latin word, said the classical Latin way: MAH-kee-nah, stress on the FIRST syllable; "ch" is a hard "k"; open vowels, "a" as in "father" (not as in "cat"), a short "ee", and a clear "ah" at the end, not "nuh". Never mah-KEE-nah.
